title: HunkMetadata
description: Per-hunk semantic metadata blob stored under refs/meta/hunks.

hunk_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the normalised hunk body (64 chars).

file.description: Path of the modified file relative to the repository root.

old_start.description: First line number in the old file covered by this hunk.

old_lines.description: Number of lines from the old file in this hunk.

new_start.description: First line number in the new file covered by this hunk.

new_lines.description: Number of lines in the new file in this hunk.

summary.description: Short (≤80 chars) one-line human-readable summary of what the hunk does.

details.description: Extended Markdown explanation of the hunk's purpose.

generated_by.description: Tool or agent that produced this metadata (e.g. 'git-hunk/v0.1.0').

generated_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when this metadata was written.
